bindings.caption: Dissolve boric acid in distilled water. Recipe-level reported vessel: ceramic crucible. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Add urea to the solution. Recipe-level reported vessel: ceramic crucible. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Heat the mixture to evaporate water. Recipe-level reported vessel: ceramic crucible. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Add trisodium citrate and grind to a fine powder. Recipe-level reported vessel: ceramic crucible. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Heat the powder in a muffle furnace. temperature: 190 °C. duration: 2 h. Recipe-level reported vessel: ceramic crucible. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Lyophilize to obtain B-gC3N4 QDs powder. Recipe-level reported vessel: ceramic crucible. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Dissolve B-gC3N4 QDs in water. Recipe-level reported vessel: ceramic crucible. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Add EDC and stir at 0 °C for 30 min. temperature: 0 °C. Recipe-level reported vessel: ceramic crucible. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Add NHS and stir for 2 h. duration: 2 h. Recipe-level reported vessel: ceramic crucible. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Add L-Cysteine and stir overnight at room temperature. Recipe-level reported vessel: ceramic crucible. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.
